horoscope: The Moon aligns with Saturn in your sign today, dear Aries, and you're inclined to take things more seriously than usual. You may have additional obligations to attend to now. Saturn’s transit of your sign feels more comfortable, meaningful, and purposeful as it heads into harmony with Jupiter. You get a strong sense that the effort you put into stabilizing your life helps free you up for more enjoyment. You are balancing responsibility and recreation more evenly now, and it feels terrific. Your love life improves as you bring a stronger sense of self into the equation. You enjoy life more as you find a better balance between work and play.

The Moon spends the day in your privacy sector, dear Taurus, and as it aligns with Saturn there, it's a signal for the need for extra time to yourself or time given to serious thought. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, and this longer-term influence positions you well to discover creative and practical ways to live, work, and settle in. You might put a problematic situation or long-term problem behind you. It’s a great time to work on areas of your life where you’ve felt a little alone, unsupported, or stagnating. Look for opportunities to improve your home life and inner world, as well as your relationship with yourself now and this week. Support for a home project may be in the spotlight now. Living conditions and family relationships improve with greater stability and security, while maintaining a spirit of openness and warmth.

The Moon aligns with Saturn in your social sector today, dear Gemini, and this serves to fuel your need to be productive. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, and today's Moon highlights this longer-term influence. This booster transit puts you in great shape for bringing more order and stability to your life now and this week, particularly with your communications, studies, friendships, and long-term dreams and goals. You can come up with truly workable ideas and methods for manifesting your innermost desires and dreams. You're learning valuable skills and combining practical and fun areas of your life. For example, you might make some money or even a full-fledged business out of a personal interest or do something you thoroughly enjoy that also contributes to a practical goal. Teamwork and communication can strengthen bonds. There’s likely to be an emphasis on learning, particularly self-taught or home-learning endeavors. You seem to bring out the best in others and to support them or offer useful advice.

Your responsibilities and performance are high on your list of concerns today, dear Cancer, as the Moon meets Saturn at the top of your solar chart. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, and today's Moon highlights this helpful transit. Now and this week, your work and money-making efforts may get a boost. You’re using tried-and-true methods to create truly workable, fruitful situations. New ways of making money or doing business can work as you apply more structure and self-discipline. It’s a strong time for practical success. Applying yourself to your work comes more naturally to you now, and your ideas find satisfying outlets. It’s also a good time to improve your reputation. Today, taking care of business feels right and even enjoyable.

The Moon spends all day in your spirit and adventure sector, dear Leo, and this suggests a craving for engaging experiences and a break from the routine or a change of scenery. The Moon meets with Saturn in this sector today, and doing some serious learning, studying, or thinking can be in store. Attempts to increase your knowledge or apply it can be particularly effective, especially if you are learning things hands-on through trial and error. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, and this longer-term aspect helps you find effective channels for expressing your unique personality and ideas. At the same time, you’re learning and developing your skills in such a way that you can better express yourself or even reinvent yourself or improve your image and personal presentation. This influence also suggests you’re earning the respect of an audience. Your reliability shines. However, it’s how you still manage to do your own thing and lead the way in combination with your constancy that earns you the most respect and rewards during this period.

The Moon is in your intimacy sector all day, dear Virgo, and you're inclined to take things a little more seriously than usual, especially with Saturn also in this area of your solar chart. You may be able to get to the bottom of a problem, or you could pour a lot of energy into something you love doing. Facing reality or dealing with a block can ultimately move you toward making improvements and getting yourself together or life back on track. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, and you get support for your efforts to sort out financial and emotional problems now and this week. It’s an excellent time for a confidant or group that helps you find some release from difficulties. Blocks in your intimate life might break through. This influence strengthens your resolve and deepens your understanding of your inner world, responses, and closest relationships. Solutions are emerging now, suggesting steady forward motion.

The Moon spends all day in the sign opposite yours, dear Libra, and your close relationships and areas of life that have fallen out of balance are in stronger focus. In fact, it's a good time to learn a few things through your interactions with a significant other, whether this is a direct or indirect "lesson". The Moon's alignment with Saturn today suggests that you'll be in a far better frame of mind if you fulfill duties and commitments rather than evade them. You might enjoy a happy agreement with a partner or friend or conversations that please you and make you feel hopeful for the future. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, and this longer-term influence boosts your friendships, partnerships, education, and communications. You’re likely to enjoy opportunities to advance your studies and learn valuable and marketable skills at this time in your life. Relationships can be both committed and exciting. You may form a partnership with a friend, or a friend could be integral to achieving your goals. Partnering with a friend in a key way or meeting a significant person through a group association can be a highlight.

The Moon spends all day in your sector of routine, habits, health, and work, dear Scorpio, and you're in the right frame of mind for attention to the systems and programs in place in your life that keep things running smoothly. The Moon meets Saturn in this sector, highlighting an emotional need to get on top of your everyday affairs. Taking care of unfinished work or getting back on track with a self-care or wellness program can be satisfying and even soothing now. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, putting you in an excellent position to identify what’s working and what needs to grow in your life. This balanced perspective can benefit you greatly now and this week — even in the months ahead! Improvements are in store, especially with your work, career, health, and money matters. You could make a highly workable lifestyle change, and it can be a slow but steady program that sticks. You might get into a healthy routine that benefits your career, reputation, and long-term goals. You are in a better position with bosses, teachers, and other people in authority who recognize your efforts.

The Moon spends all day in your creativity sector, dear Sagittarius, and your need for recreation and leisure is in the spotlight. You may be drawn to spending time on productive things, finding it soothing and satisfying. You can have great success working on a creative project or refining a skill, studying, or adding structure or form to a project. It's, in fact, a great time for design work. Your ruler, Jupiter, heads into harmony with Saturn, and this is a time of measured, meaningful changes and improvements that build on the existing structures in your life. You can more easily give form to your creative ideas and dream up ways to better express yourself while keeping your feet on the ground and meeting your responsibilities. It can be a time to turn your ideas into concrete realities. A creative or communications endeavor can thrive as you develop your craft or techniques. The key now is balancing optimism and practicality, and this longer-term influence helps you do just that.

The Moon and Saturn align in your home and family sector today, dear Capricorn, and you're likely to focus on the practical side of your domestic world or personal life. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, and today's Moon highlights this longer-term influence. It's a time of productivity and meaningful improvements on emotional levels, with family, and with finances, especially debts. You can be sorting out your living conditions and money situation. You may be able to work out an improved relationship or living setup that’s both reliable and happy. New ideas for home improvements can come to you now. You might get the support you need for home repairs, moves, or other developments. A supportive atmosphere in the family and in your home life can be in the spotlight, and it's satisfying.

The Moon aligns with serious Saturn and harmonizes with Jupiter today, dear Aquarius, and you're inclined to want to concentrate on your projects, or there can be an important conversation or work to do now. A bit of self-discipline can go a long way today! In truth, the Moon is highlighting a longer-term influence that's with you: Jupiter trine Saturn. This booster transit supports your efforts to improve and update your relationships, studies, and projects. Whether it’s a friendship, partnership, course of study, or special interest, you’re making it work. You can enjoy practical success that’s comfortable and reliable but also fun and stimulating. New ideas that you refine and make work for you can come from a partner or friend now and in the weeks ahead. A partnership can improve through excellent communication. There can be a greater love of the less glamorous aspects of your work, studies, and projects, and you are capable of tremendous effort to further your goals.

You are likely to derive more satisfaction than usual from getting your practical affairs in order today, dear Pisces, with the Moon in alignment with Saturn. Jupiter and Saturn are heading into harmony, and this longer-term influence puts you in great shape for the practical areas of your life, including finances and work, but also regarding your health and friendships. You have a greater love for attending to your work, chores, and wellness routines, along with self-discipline that contributes to better health and greater satisfaction with your duties and daily affairs. Overall, this can be a comfortable period for making money, your working life, and pursuing health goals. You can find the right balance between growth and tradition. It's a time of greater productivity.
